subject: Nice decals.
author: kevlar0
body:
Good job on the shirt prints Sonic, they look the bizz, although I did prefer the elite one, I would say that one covered all the Burnout games, which is what this site is all about.

Its a real shame Paradise didn't do it for some of the Revenge players on here, I know I would have been hotly contesting my road times with most of you. And contarary to what you think, the Ranked racing does work now the bug issues have been fixed, Most of the top 100 spots in Paradise R/R are taken up with ex Revenge players who have taken the time to learn the routes, some even have there Gamertags mentioned for submitting the track when the route is shown at the start of the race.

Criterion must have done something right with Paradise, as there were over 90 rooms open at one point over the weekend (strangely enough only 4 were C&R rooms, and this number doesn't include invite only and R/R rooms).

It must be the Revenge forums that are dead, because the Paradise fansites I visit and post on are buzzing at the moment and have been for the last 18 months. and its not just continually calling each other noobs and who is the best racer threads or slagging other games off.

Anyhow, its your loss. And when they do sunsettle the Revenge servers all you will have left are memories of Burnout.

And Nero is a gay noob, and the 1 in his Gamertag is his IQ, :) LMAO

He's not the messiah, he's a very naughty boy.

subject: Cool Designs!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Nice one Sonic! 👍 😃

I think we have all said all we can say about Revenge, and other then the odd new bit of DLC there isn't much to discuss Paradise wise either... Although we could always start writing a Revenge Blast from the past article! 😛 

However, there are a few new games to look forward to which I am sure will be mentioned more then a few times on these pages over the coming months. Fuel and Split/Second! 🥵

Then there is the Big Surf Island to look forward to, although we wont be talking about that too much until we get a release date! 🏝️

Real life has taken over from Burnout for Xandu and I for a while anyway (Real Life and Peggle!)... although after the move I am hoping to start playing a bit more again.

And as always, you can blog about anything you like here (as long as it complies with the Terms of Use). It doesn't ALL have to be about Burnout! 🙂
